exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted in two stages: (1) Preliminary Examination comprising 150 objective questions across General Studies, General Science/Math, and Mental Ability (+4, -1 marking) for shortlisting in 1:5 ratio; (2) Main Examination comprising Paper 1 Hindi (qualifying, 30% threshold) and Paper 2 General Knowledge/Science/Maths/Reasoning (600 marks, determining final merit); plus practical typing tests for clerical posts.

stages.source_label: BSSC 2nd Inter Level Advt. No. 02/23(A) Scheme & Syllabus

papers.paper_name: General Studies, General Science, Mathematics & Mental Ability Test
papers.negative_marking: 1 mark deducted per wrong answer; 4 marks awarded per correct answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Top candidates shortlisted in 1:5 ratio; minimum qualifying threshold: General 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST/Women/PwD 32%

stages.source_label: BSSC 2nd Inter Level Advt. No. 02/23(A) Scheme & Syllabus

papers.negative_marking: 1 mark deducted per wrong answer; 4 marks awarded per correct answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory 30% marks; Paper 2 evaluated only for candidates obtaining qualifying marks in Paper 1

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: General Studies, General Science, Mathematics & Reasoning
papers.negative_marking: 1 mark deducted per wrong answer; 4 marks awarded per correct answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Final merit rank is computed strictly on marks obtained in Paper 2

stages.stage_name: Stage 3: Typing / Skill Test & Document Verification
stages.source_label: BSSC 2nd Inter Level Advt. No. 02/23(A) Skill Test Guidelines

papers.paper_name: Hindi Typing Test (30 wpm in Mangal font / Remington) & English Typing (35 wpm) for LDC posts
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying standard prescribed by BSSC for clerical/stenographer posts

financial_package.note: Pay scale shown for Panchayat Secretary (Level 3, Basic ₹21,700). Other major posts like Rajasva Karamchari and Lower Division Clerk (LDC) are placed in Level 2 (Basic ₹19,900).
financial_package.pay_source_label: BSSC 2nd Inter Level Advt. No. 02/23(A) Vacancy & Pay Matrix Details
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 with standard 58% DA (₹12,586), HRA (8% to 16% depending on block/district headquarters posting: ₹1,736 to ₹3,472), Medical Allowance (₹1,000), and Transport Allowance. In-hand reflects 10% NPS employee deduction on Basic+DA (₹3,429) and professional tax.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) or government staff quarters in block/subdivision headquarters
Medical allowance (₹1,000/month) and treatment reimbursement under state rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Paid casual, medical, and earned leaves with leave encashment provision
